name: 42-session-records
prompts: The data/ directory holds many small record files. Each has the lines 'id: TOKEN_NNNN', 'owner: <name>' and 'size: <number>' followed by a blob. Write owners.txt listing every distinct owner, one per line, sorted. The tree is large; inspect it with tools rather than guessing.
Write inventory.txt: every id in data/, one per line, sorted. Do not invent ids.
Which owner has the most records? Write that owner's name alone into top_owner.txt.
Write sizes.txt: for each owner, the sum of the size field over all of their records, as lines '<owner> <total>' sorted by owner.
Every record owned by carol is being archived: in each of carol's files change the id prefix TOKEN_ to ARCHIVED_ (keep the number). Do not touch any other file.

Update inventory.txt so it reflects the renames you made in the previous step (the archived ids appear with their new prefix; keep it sorted, one id per line). Then reply with just the number of files you changed in the previous step.
